# Curated Feeds
> Privacy-first RSS reader for Android. Beautiful cards, swipe-to-save, offline-ready, zero ads, zero tracking. Built by Rajat Kashyap in Flutter. Free worldwide.

## Pages

- [Home](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/): product overview, features, FAQ, direct download
- [Blog](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/blog/): RSS tips, productivity, content curation
- [About](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/about/): founder story, mission, technical stack, timeline
- [Screenshots](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/screenshots/): UI previews (home feed, swipe gestures)
- [RSS Feed Finder](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/tools/find-feed/): finds any site's feed URL from its markup or common paths
- [RSS Publication Directory](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/directory/): 50 verified publication feed endpoints across tech, news, and science
- [OPML Bundles (2027)](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/opml/): pre-packaged XML bundles for tech, cybersecurity, AI, and global news for 1-click import into any reader
- [Starter Feeds](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/sources/): curated high-signal feed directory with copy-paste URLs
- [AI & ML RSS Feeds](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/sources/ai/): verified research labs, papers, and engineering logs
- [Developer RSS Feeds](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/sources/developer/): software architecture, systems, and engineering blogs
- [Why Curated Feeds](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/why/): honest comparison with Feedly, Inoreader, NetNewsWire
- [Curated Feeds vs Feedly](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/why/feedly/): head-to-head on accounts, free-plan limits, and sync
- [Curated Feeds vs Inoreader](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/why/inoreader/): head-to-head on rules, filters, and archive search
- [Curated Feeds vs Feeder](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/why/feeder/): card-swipe triage vs classic headline lists for privacy users
- [Curated Feeds vs FeedFlow](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/why/feedflow/): tactile card decks vs minimalist browser-tab reader mode
- [Curated Feeds vs Read You](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/why/read-you/): zero-config triage vs Material You multi-pane Reeder styling
- [Curated Feeds vs NewsBlur](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/why/newsblur/): unlimited local reading vs 64-site caps and subscriptions
- [Use Cases](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/use-cases/): six reading profiles mapped to real features
- [Changelog](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/changelog/): every public build, newest first
- [Press Kit](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/press/): boilerplate, product facts, brand assets
- [Privacy Policy](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/privacy/): zero-data-collection policy

## Machine-readable

Every page has a Markdown twin at the same URL with `.md` appended, for example
[about.md](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/about.md).
